      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Implements native Cap'n Proto request cancellation across the IPC layer to avoid out-of-band interrupt calls. As reviewer ryanofsky notes, clients can cancel blocking requests natively by dropping request promises rather than issuing separate IPC calls, simplifying both clients and servers."
    },
    {
      "name": "mining",
      "member": true,

      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Improves the blocking mining interface by replacing out-of-band interrupt methods with cancellation arguments. This follows the agreed design approach from RFC #33575 ('RFC: Cancelling waitNext calls in the IPC mining interface') to simplify external miner integration."
